mismatches.mismatch: The backend root still serves the old splash page instead of the maintained Vue app.
mismatches.user_impact: Users landing on the local backend root do not reach the Protocol v1 beta UI.
mismatches.required_fix: Serve the maintained frontend entrypoint or replace the stale splash page in UI-2.

mismatches.mismatch: The committed zip artifact appears unrelated to the current Vue application.
mismatches.user_impact: Manual packaging or deployment could publish the wrong UI bundle.
mismatches.required_fix: Rebuild or remove the zip and use source plus rebuilt dist as the only trusted frontend artifacts.

mismatches.frontend_file_function: zoidbergcoin-ui/src/pages/Dashboard.vue computed submission grouping and mint messaging
mismatches.mismatch: Dashboard behavior still depends on legacy persisted status strings instead of Protocol v1 lifecycle and finality fields.
mismatches.user_impact: Users cannot distinguish certified, canonical, confirmed, and finalized states.
mismatches.required_fix: Rebase submission grouping, labels, and mint results on protocol_v1_lifecycle, confirmation, and finality fields.

mismatches.frontend_file_function: zoidbergcoin-ui/src/pages/Blockchain.vue and zoidbergcoin-ui/src/pages/Dashboard.vue block explorer cards
mismatches.mismatch: Explorer views omit block version, network binding, canonical/finality state, and render genesis like a normal content block.
mismatches.user_impact: The frozen Protocol v1 block and genesis model is hidden behind pre-freeze explorer assumptions.
mismatches.required_fix: Render explicit block/genesis identity and finality state in the explorer.

mismatches.frontend_file_function: zoidbergcoin-ui/src/pages/Dashboard.vue and zoidbergcoin-ui/src/pages/Blockchain.vue content preview and storage-state logic
mismatches.mismatch: The UI treats auxiliary download/storage state as the practical source of truth and ignores embedded media metadata.
mismatches.user_impact: Accepted content can look missing or remote even when the authoritative bytes are in the block.
mismatches.required_fix: Add MODEL A-aware detail behavior and use embedded media metadata in accepted block views.

mismatches.mismatch: The frontend shows network_name only and never surfaces canonical network_id, protocol_version, or genesis hash.
mismatches.user_impact: Users see the runtime alias but not the frozen Public Testnet v1 consensus identity.
mismatches.required_fix: Show compact Public Testnet v1 network identity in the key chain and wallet views.

mismatches.mismatch: The UI highlights MetaMask chainId and invalidates ZoidbergChain verification on any chainChanged event.
mismatches.user_impact: Users can infer that Ethereum network selection controls ZoidbergChain identity.
mismatches.required_fix: De-emphasize chainId and explain the difference between wallet network state and ZoidbergChain consensus identity.

mismatches.mismatch: Vote challenge issued_at/expires_at metadata is ignored and expired challenges fall back to generic errors.
mismatches.user_impact: Users can sign stale vote forms and get opaque failures.
mismatches.required_fix: Add vote challenge refresh/retry UX and explicit expired-message handling.

mismatches.mismatch: Signed text submissions omit text_content in the final submission request.
mismatches.user_impact: Text submission previews and serialized submission text can be blank or inconsistent later in the UI.
mismatches.required_fix: Include mirrored text_content when finalizing a signed text submission.

mismatches.mismatch: Transfer UI ignores version/network/expiry metadata and only partially explains settlement context.
mismatches.user_impact: Transfers work, but users cannot see the frozen Protocol v1 identity and settlement model.
mismatches.required_fix: Surface transaction identity fields and add expiry-aware transfer UX.

mismatches.backend_route_function: dev and ops routes exposed behind showDevelopmentTools()
mismatches.mismatch: Shared public pages still contain dev/ops actions behind environment flags.
mismatches.user_impact: A misconfigured build could expose operator workflows in the normal tester UI.
mismatches.required_fix: Move dev/ops controls into explicitly separate operator or local-dev surfaces.

mismatches.mismatch: Vote, submission, network, genesis, and finality failures mostly fall through generic error formatting.
mismatches.user_impact: Users receive errors without protocol-aware next steps.
mismatches.required_fix: Add targeted handling for expired challenge, wrong network, wrong signer, already-minted, and legacy/reset-required cases.

mismatches.mismatch: User-facing copy still leans on phrases such as Certified Meme, Genesis / Legacy, and alias-only Network.
mismatches.user_impact: The UI language understates the frozen Protocol v1 model.
mismatches.required_fix: Refresh labels and helper copy to align with Protocol v1 terminology.

mismatches.mismatch: A dedicated Blockchain.vue explorer remains in source even though /blockchain redirects to /activity.
mismatches.user_impact: Duplicate explorer implementations can drift apart.
mismatches.required_fix: Consolidate or intentionally retire the duplicate explorer in UI-2.

mismatches.mismatch: Deployable artifacts still depend on a manual rebuild/publish flow and can drift from source.
mismatches.user_impact: UI-2 source fixes could fail to ship if dist publishing is skipped.
mismatches.required_fix: Rebuild and publish dist as an explicit UI-2 completion step.

required_fields: Protocol v1-aware settlement and network messaging

missing_ui_features: User-facing confirmation and finality display using the frozen 2/6 depth rules
Canonical network_id and genesis hash display
MODEL A-aware accepted media handling using embedded media metadata
Vote challenge expiry and retry UX
Transfer challenge expiry and retry UX
Protocol-aware error messaging for wrong network, wrong signer, already minted, and reset-required failures
